title: When Calls the Heart: A Call from the Past
overview: From celebrated author Janette Oke comes a rigorous and romantic adventure as epic as the wide frontier. Erin Krakow, Jack Wagner and Pascale Huttonstar in When Calls the Heart: A Call from the Past. Hope Valley is in a stir: a legendary train robber has been spotted in the area, Elizabeth is putting together a town library, and Gowen's newfound success has put him in competition for workers with Lee…and in court with Jesse! Amidst it all, Lucas must contend with a figure from his past coming back to haunt him.
